blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Central rose from 7 in June to 8 in September (+14.3%), and 4 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 0.6% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Central?
Central also had 14 houses listed and 1 sold in September, against 8 condos and townhomes listed. The Central houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 condos and townhomes listed in Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Central had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in Central over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
